messages.text: Welcome back, everyone. Staff sync moves to 9:30 Mondays starting this week.
Noted - I will update the shared calendar invite.
Anniversary lecture series: three speakers confirmed for spring. Holding the hall for the second Thursdays.
I will draft the member announcement once the third date locks.
Roof assessment for the Bull Street property is back - repairs scoped under the restoration grant. Summary in the drive.
Actuals are tracking within the grant line. I flagged the January drawdown for the finance review.
Docent orientation is Saturday at 9. Amos is leading the Friday walking tour this month.
December close is done - statement of activities posted for Thursday's review with Reginald.
Register's keyed. I just used 45 a plot like last year, it's close enough.
Corrigendum 1 to the charges is out, water is 22 now, use that for the 2027 invoices.
Raised beds can go to anyone this year, nobody in band A wants them.
Quarry Field is in poles, I always call a pole 30 square metres, easier sums.
W-1007 is back on, I saw the reinstatement go through.
Hester Quinlan's assessment came in, she's band A.
Ruling from me: Brook Meadow BM-27 goes to Ffion Westlake (W-1033) this round, she has waited long enough. Confirm here when it's done.
Ashworth have three spare plots on their list too, we might as well fill them from ours.
Ruling from me: let the raised bed BM-46 to Bernard Ocampo (W-1002) this round, it's only 40 m² so it's the cheapest rent going for a pensioner. Confirm here when it's done.
Please don't reply in here about the round, I'll pick it up.
